Subject: POC kickoff — SableHealth hands-on & sandbox access

Hi Jane / Mike —

Great to start moving toward the hands-on POC. We recommend a 2.5 hour kickoff session that combines a short demo with immediately actionable working time: prompt review, routing rules, and a small load test using your sample traffic. Proposed dates/times (Pacific):

- Tue Mar 10 — 9:00–11:30am PT
- Wed Mar 11 — 10:00am–12:30pm PT

Please let us know which slot works, or suggest alternatives. To make the session productive, could you confirm the following before the kickoff?

1) Sandbox access: list of allowed client IPs (or CIDR ranges) for our staging endpoints
2) Service account or API key provisioning path you prefer (we can provide a short-lived key if you want)
3) Preferred staging hostname (if self-hosted) or we will route to our shared staging at https://staging.redwood.example
4) Example prompt set or a 10–20 request sample for the load test

I've attached a short POC prep checklist with the full agenda and environment steps. Dev will provision a scoped API key for the session and provide instructions on rate limits and token scopes.

Attachments: poc_prep_checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to coordinate times.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the checklist.

On the environment items: we will provide a service account with limited scopes and an IP allowlist from our SRE team. Two quick clarifications:

- Can the sandbox API key be scoped to embeddings + chat only? We won't need admin/model upload rights.
- Do you have a recommended traffic profile for a small load test (requests per second and typical token sizes)?

I'll loop in Mike (SRE) for the IP list. Also please send any staging hostnames or CORS requirements we should add to our side.

Thanks —
Jane

Hi Jane — great, Mar 12 works on our side. I've penciled in Fri Mar 12, 9:30–12:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite once we finalize attendees.

Answers to your environment questions:

- Yes — we can scope the sandbox API key to embeddings + chat only. Dev will create the key with the minimal scopes you requested and will mark it to auto-expire after 7 days.
- Recommended small load profile for the session: 20 concurrent users, burst to 50 rps for 60s, average request size ~600 tokens. That should be enough to verify batching and routing behavior without over-provisioning.

For allowlist: please send the CIDRs Mike will provide. We will add them to our staging firewall and to the reverse-proxy CORS config. Our staging endpoint for the session will be: https://staging.redwood.example (TLS certs in place). If you host inside a VPC/Private setup, let us know and we'll provide an alternative IPs list.

I've attached a short text file with the exact steps Dev will perform to create the scoped key and the headers you'll need to send (Authorization: Bearer <token>).

Attachments: sandbox-instructions.txt
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_poc-runbook

I'll follow up once Dev shares the key delivery method.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — SableHealth hands-on & sandbox access

Following up with the concrete steps I'll perform and a short snippet you can use during the session.

Provisioning notes (what I'll do):
1) Create a scoped API key (embeddings + chat only), label: SH-POC-Mar12, TTL: 7d.
2) Add SableHealth CIDRs to staging firewall (please send CIDRs ASAP).
3) Configure rate-limit policy: baseline 20 concurrent connections, burst to 50 rps with backoff 500ms.
4) Share the token via our secure Secrets Delivery link (one-time access).

Headers / quick cURL example (use staging host):

curl -X POST "https://staging.redwood.example/v1/chat" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4r-lite","input":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize patient intake notes"}]}'

Notes:
- Token scope will block model uploads and admin endpoints.
- For local CORS, add staging.redwood.example to your allowed origins; we will support preflight OPTIONS.
- If you expect longer-context prompts during the session, tell us so we can enable a larger KV cache for that model.

I'll provision everything and reply with the Secrets Delivery link once the firewall change is live. Attaching the SableHealth requirements spreadsheet your procurement asked for (filled with our suggested SLA and support contacts).

Attachments: sablehealth_requirements.xlsx
